subject: Preflight credits for dark-launch throughput test
messages:
From: Devon Price <devon@opsly.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Preflight credits request — dark-launch throughput sweep

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the great demo last week — the team is excited. We have a narrow dark-launch window to validate throughput and tail-latency for our assistant (small cohort of users, synthetic ramp to 5k QPS for 90m). Can Redwood provide a one-off credit allocation to cover the preflight test?

What we need:
- ~150k token-equivalent credits (estimate)
- Time window: Aug 21 02:00–04:00 UTC (roughly overnight for our region)
- Short-term SLA: temporary burst access, no long-term billing changes

Attached is our instrumentation plan and a CSV with expected request profile. We can share a short runbook and will route telemetry into the Redwood Console.

Happy to hop on a short call if you need more context.

Thanks,
Devon
Devon Price
Head of Platform, Opsly
devon@opsly.ai

Attachments: darklaunch-load-plan.csv (text/csv)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Devon Price <devon@opsly.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preflight credits request — dark-launch throughput sweep

Devon — appreciate the detailed plan. This is the kind of preflight we expect. Quick questions before I escalate for a provisional sponsorship:

- Can you confirm the traffic pattern in the CSV is p99 request size (tokens) or average?
- Do you need a hard reservation (guaranteed capacity) or a temporary credit voucher we can consume from hosted?

Tentatively we can approve a one-off credit voucher for the run if the test is scoped and we have a monitoring hook in the Console. Jordan — can you weigh in on the limit and guardrails? If we greenlight, Marissa in finance will issue the voucher and include any compliance notes.

If it's helpful, we can condition the allocation on a 2-hour run window and a post-run summary.

—Karthik
VP, Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Devon Price <devon@opsly.ai>
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 14:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Preflight credits request — dark-launch throughput sweep

Thanks Karthik / Devon. I'm comfortable approving a provisional voucher under these conditions:

1) Voucher capped at 175k token-equivalent (gives 15% buffer).
2) Run window locked to Aug 21 02:00–04:00 UTC; any overage must be pre-approved.
3) Opsly engineers must enable the Redwood trace hook and grant our SRE read access to the console for the run window.
4) We'll put a soft throttling policy that falls back to a smaller model variant at 95% usage to protect broader tenant capacity.

I'll authorize the credit in our system and loop in Marissa for the formal voucher and any paperwork. Jordan
Sr. Customer Success, Redwood Inference
